'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 2 Reid Smith LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Username:''' 3MW0J8
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
